- [LDET.1.8.2] **`now()` / tick timing.** Wall-clock reads in live mode
  vary between runs — obviously. In replay, `now()` is
  whatever the recording said it was at that instant; in
  simulation, it's what the test harness sets. Rules that
  compare `now()` produce the same answer every time the
  recording is replayed. Both engine clocks — the wall clock
  `now()` reads and the monotonic clock every relative-time
  mechanism reads — are recorded inputs, not real-time
  quantities ([LTIM.2.8.5]).
